localApi: Local API · dataset and bounded execution
subtitle: Select a table. Inspect its source values and inferred schema.
rangeHint: Include unique, non-empty text headers. The server checks whether this range is a valid table.
suggestion: Suggested from worksheet metadata; adjust for blank rows or offset tables.
emptyHint: Upload an Excel workbook, choose its table boundaries, then preview the selection.
readyHint: Check the worksheet and range, then preview the selection.
sampleNote: Sample indices are not Excel row numbers. Empty rows are omitted.
sampleLimit: Up to {{count}} sample rows · values up to 200 characters
noData: Headers found; no non-empty data records in this selection.
selectColumn: Select a column heading to inspect its metadata.
observed: Based on the selected records; not factual verification.
noWarnings: No schema warnings in this selection.
sessionOnly: Local session · external calls require explicit opt-in
pendingSelection: Preview cleared. Apply the current selection to inspect it.
scrollHint: Scroll horizontally to inspect all columns.
warning.emptyColumn: {{column}}: no non-empty values; type is unknown.
warning.time: {{column}}: {{count}} time-only values without a canonical type.
warning.truncated: Sample reduced to fit the profile size limit.
warning.generic: {{column}}: additional schema warning from the profiler.
error.invalid_selection: Check the worksheet and A1 range. The first selected row must contain unique, non-empty text headers.
error.upload_too_large: Upload a file up to 10 MiB.
error.invalid_workbook: Cannot read this workbook. Upload a valid, unencrypted .xlsx file.
error.worksheet_limit: Use up to 16 worksheets per workbook; each table must fit 5,001 rows, 100 columns and 100,000 cells.
error.workbook_limit: Workbook exceeds the local archive or metadata limits. Use a smaller workbook.
error.workspace_full: The local workspace is full. Download artifacts, then restart the backend to clear retained datasets, plans and jobs.
error.dataset_not_found: This dataset is no longer available. Upload the workbook again.
error.invalid_request: Check the upload or selection fields.
error.internal_error: The local request failed. Please try again.
error.request_failed: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
error.network_error: Cannot reach the local API. Start the backend and try again.
error.rangeSyntax: Enter an A1 cell or rectangle, for example A1:E11.
error.rangeOrder: The last column and row must not precede the first column and header row.
error.excelLimits: The range exceeds Excel worksheet limits.
workflow.title: Plan and run
workflow.bounds: 1–20 data rows · up to 12 steps · one active run
workflow.selectionLimit: Select 1–20 data rows within columns A:CV, then preview again.
workflow.mappingHint: Map each named plan output to an Excel column. Capitals: distance → E. Mountains: height → C. Existing non-empty cells are preserved.
workflow.network: Allow external network requests for planning and execution
workflow.networkHint: Live planning requires the server network gate (--allow-network in the local launcher), a model and an API key in Provider / Model settings, and your separate consent. Instructions and sample data may be sent to OpenAI. No fixture fallback.
workflow.fixture: Offline fixture execution — test evidence only; external responses were injected.
workflow.unresolved: Some records remain unresolved. Published results contain only verified output values; inspect the row issues and audit.
workflow.outcomes: Per-record outcomes (expand for values and evidence)
workflow.reviewUnavailable: Review / Resume: Not available in E2E-0.
error.network_disabled: External network access is disabled. Opt in here and set ENRICHMENT_ALLOW_NETWORK=1 before starting the server.
error.llm_not_configured: Planning model is missing. Choose one in Provider / Model settings.
error.missing_api_key: Planning API key is missing. Add one in Provider / Model settings.
error.planning_failed: The model could not return a usable plan. Try a clearer instruction or submit an existing plan.
error.approval_required: Explicitly approve the current plan before running.
error.approval_mismatch: The fingerprint does not match. Generate and review a fresh plan.
error.source_changed: The source changed. Upload it again and review a fresh plan.
error.job_busy: Another run is active. Wait for it to finish or cancel it.
error.invalid_plan: The plan failed validation. Review the validation errors.
error.plan_json: Enter a valid EnrichmentPlan JSON object.
error.plan_not_found: The plan is no longer available. Generate a new plan.
error.job_not_found: The job is no longer available. The server may have restarted.
error.artifact_not_ready: The artifact has not been published.
error.request_too_large: Plan requests must fit within 64 KiB.
error.plan_limit: The plan exceeds the backend limits.
ws.datasetHint: Prepare your source table and define the enrichment task.
ws.planHint: Inspect the workflow, check its outputs, then explicitly approve.
ws.executionHint: Run the approved plan and inspect the actual outcome.
ws.reviewHint: Settle ambiguous names and fill in the remaining rows.
ws.exportHint: Inspect published record outcomes and download your files.
ws.taskHint: Describe the values you need, then choose where to write verified results.
ws.invalidateWarning: Editing source, instruction, mapping or policy clears the current approval and result view. Previous runs remain in Diagnostics.
ws.previewFirst: Preview a valid table to configure enrichment.
ws.mappingHint: Existing: keep headers and occupied cells. New: unique header, after all worksheet columns.
ws.mappingInvalid: Choose distinct columns and headers within A:CV. New columns must follow all known worksheet columns.
ws.offlineValidation: Supplied plans can be validated offline. Execution still requires separate network consent.
ws.aiRequirements: AI planning requires network consent and a model configured on the backend. Check Provider / Model settings for setup.
ws.staticGraph: Static plan · no per-node execution events available
ws.noPlan: Build a plan in Dataset to inspect its real steps and dependencies here.
ws.approvalRecorded: Approval recorded for this exact source-bound plan.
ws.approvalHint: Approval applies only to this exact plan and source selection. It does not start execution.
ws.metricsPending: Record counts appear when the backend publishes actual results.
ws.runningHint: The backend is working. Detailed progress is not reported by this API. You can visit any workspace while polling continues.
ws.terminalHint: The backend has finished. Inspect the summary and published artifacts.
ws.startHint: Execution begins only after explicit plan approval and a separate start action.
ws.executionNetwork: Return to Dataset to opt in to external requests, then rebuild and approve the plan.
ws.retryHint: Retry starts a new bounded job with the same approved binding. It does not resume unresolved records.
ws.reviewPending: Run a plan and wait for its audit to see unresolved issues.
ws.groupingHint: Grouped by reported error code and affected record. Dependency failures are consequences, not additional root causes.
ws.noIssues: No unresolved operation issues in the published audit.
ws.noRowDetails: This job did not publish per-record results. Inspect its status and Diagnostics.
ws.exportPending: Published record outcomes will appear after execution. Download buttons follow actual artifact availability.
ws.filenameHint: The .xlsx extension is added automatically. Save location and Save As prompts follow your browser settings.
ws.consentState: External network consent in this session
ws.historyHint: Last 8 runs retained for this browser session; these are not the current source binding. Reload clears this local view.
ws.exportDetail: Download the published workbook and its reproducible audit. Unresolved values remain empty; occupied source cells are preserved.
ws.outputPreviewHint: Values below come from successful audited output steps. The workbook preserves occupied source cells.
provider.name: Provider
provider.ephemeral: Model and key are held only in backend process memory and are lost on restart. Saving does not contact OpenAI or approve or run a plan.
provider.unavailable: Cannot check provider readiness. Retry in Provider / Model settings.
provider.networkDisabled: Server network access is disabled. Restart the local launcher with --allow-network to enable live planning.
provider.modelMissing: Choose a planning model in Provider / Model settings.
provider.keyMissing: No API key configured. Add one in Provider / Model settings.
provider.ready: Live planning configuration is ready. Credentials and model access are verified only when generating a plan.
provider.offline: Injected offline planning responses are active. This is not a live OpenAI request.
provider.consentMissing: Enable external-request consent in Dataset before generating a plan.
provider.keyPresent: Key configured (never returned to the browser)
provider.replaceHint: Leave empty to keep the current key. Enter a new key to replace it. The input clears after handoff or closing settings.
provider.saved: Settings applied for this backend process.
provider.removed: API key removed from this backend process.
provider.saveFailed: Could not apply settings. Check the local backend and try again; re-enter the key if needed.
provider.localOnly: Browser configuration is disabled. Start with: uv run --locked python -m ai_data_enrichment.local_server --allow-network. Environment startup defaults remain supported.
error.configuration_forbidden: Browser configuration requires the trusted local launcher and same-origin access.
error.invalid_api_key: Enter an API key without whitespace.
workflow.intentConflict: Capability contracts passed. A conflict with your instruction blocks approval.
workflow.parameterHint: Optional restrictions may be omitted. Literal city lookup needs no capital-status restriction. Row ambiguity is checked using provider evidence during execution.
review.title: Choices needed
review.intro: The source returned more than one match for these names. Choose the one you mean, or leave it empty. Names to decide: {{items}} · rows affected: {{rows}}.
review.nothingToChoose: There is nothing to choose in this run. The names below had no usable match, so their cells stay empty.
review.reason.only_selectable_candidate: the only match the source confirmed
review.blocker.unverified: the source did not confirm it
review.blocker.type: it is a different kind of object
review.leaveEmptyHint: The cells in these rows stay empty.
review.match.label: matched by name
review.informationalHint: Check the spelling and the country in the workbook, then build and run a new plan.
review.status.unresolved: the source returned no matching entry
review.status.incomplete_verification: the source could not confirm any candidate
review.status.needs_review: none of the candidates can be chosen
review.sidebarIdle: Nothing to decide for this run.
review.resumeHint: Starts a new run of the same approved plan with your choices. Each choice is checked against the source again. The earlier result stays in Diagnostics.
review.continued: This run continues an earlier one after review.
error.invalid_decision: A choice is no longer valid. Open Review again and choose from the listed candidates.
error.no_decisions: Choose a candidate for at least one name.
error.review_not_available: This run has nothing left to review.
